name: Forehand drives in a row
howToMeasure: Forehand cross-court at a steady pace. Best of three tries; count only your own hits that land on the table.

name: Backhand drives in a row
howToMeasure: Backhand cross-court at a steady pace. Best of three tries; count only your own hits.

name: Backhand pushes in a row
howToMeasure: Backhand push rally; only count balls that stay low over the net. Best of three tries.

name: Loops against backspin on the table
howToMeasure: 10 backspin balls to your forehand, one at a time. Count the loops that land.

name: Serves in the target zone
howToMeasure: Short target: a 40 cm zone next to the net on the receiver's side. Long target: the last 30 cm before their end line. Alternate short and long; count serves that land in the right zone.

name: Two-point footwork in a row
howToMeasure: Ball alternates forehand corner and middle at a steady pace; count forehands in a row. Best of three tries.

name: Alternating bounces on the bat
howToMeasure: Bounce the ball on your bat, switching faces every bounce. Best of three tries.
